steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: AO1: Demonstrate knowledge and understanding of geological ideas and methods (35%) | Key Fact: AO2: Apply knowledge and understanding of geology to familiar and unfamiliar contexts (35%) | Key Fact: AO3: Analyse, interpret and evaluate geological information and methods (30%) | Key Fact: Mathematical skills: calculating gradients, using standard form, ratios, percentages, interpreting graphs

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on key terms from geology exam technique, and one past-paper question.
